_note: All prices are Alex-editable. Fields marked _confirm: true need Alex's sign-off before launch.

mowing.description: Per-visit pricing. Base covers up to 5,000 sqft. Add $6 per additional 1,000 sqft. Biweekly service is 1.25x per-visit. Overgrown/first-time cleanup is 1.5x.

mulch.description: Price per cubic yard installed. Bed area (sqft) x depth (inches) / 324 = yards needed. Minimum job is $250.

leaf_cleanup.description: Range based on yard size and leaf coverage. AI photo analysis or customer self-assessment determines tier.

gutter.description: Flat rate by story count. Add $40 if gutter guards are installed.

tree_trim.description: Range by tree size. Removal is 1.8x trim price. Each hazard adds 15%. XL trees or near powerlines always require Alex's review.

storm_cleanup.description: Always review-only. Storm damage varies too much for automated pricing.
